ModMetaData.name: TechLevelFixes - Pickle tests
ModMetaData.author: Nelim
ModMetaData.description:
In-game functional tests for Nelim's Tech Level Fixes, run by Pickle. Development only: never published.
The scenarios only read defs, so they change nothing in the game and need no save. A scenario whose corrected mod is not in the modlist fails on its first step, naming that mod.
